title: Soft Drinks - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue, at home (e.g., revenue generated in supermarkets and convenience stores) in the Soft Drinks market amounts to US$459.20bn in 2026.
Revenue, out-of-home (e.g., revenue generated in restaurants and bars) amounts to US$305.21bn in 2026.
Revenue, combined amounts to US$764.40bn in 2026.
The revenue, at home is expected to grow annually by 4.75% (CAGR 2026-2030).
In global comparison, most revenue, at home is generated United States (US$74bn in 2026).
In relation to total population figures, the average revenue per capita, at home of US$58.10 are generated in 2026.
In the Soft Drinks market, volume, at home is expected to amount to 266.05bn L by 2026.
Volume, out-of-home is expected to amount to 38.13bn L in 2026.
Volume, combined is expected to amount to 304.18bn L in 2026.
The Soft Drinks market is expected to show a volume growth, at home of 0.7% in 2027.
The average volume per person, at home in the Soft Drinks market is expected to amount to 33.66L in 2026.
